title: Phantom Shooter
description: Line up slick action-movie shots as a stealth agent—aim clean angles, neutralize rival henchmen in rapid firefights, and clear every tactical stage.
controls: Hold and drag to aim your laser sight, release to fire crisp shots, and clear all targets in each mission.

zh-CN.title: 幽灵射手
zh-CN.description: 爽快特工潜行枪战闯关：化身王牌幽灵特工拉线精准瞄准，枪枪爆头或巧借角度干脆利落清剿全员目标！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动控制射击方向与瞄准线，松手开火消灭关卡内全部敌人。
